header.title: Andrej Dunaev
header.subtitle: Gas Infrastructure Engineer | Piping Design & Technical Review
header.description: I design piping layouts and gas metering assemblies, review multidisciplinary drawings and build tools for engineering document checks.

directions.title: Three directions
directions.description: Explore three directions of my work.

about.p1: I have personally designed piping layouts and gas metering assemblies in AutoCAD and SolidWorks. My work covers gas pipelines, compressor and gas metering stations, and surface facilities for underground gas storage.
about.p2: I review piping, mechanical and civil drawings alongside instrumentation and P&ID documents in the same project package. At IDC and Comita, I have coordinated technical interfaces across multiple design institutes, as well as with contractors, suppliers and clients.
about.p3: I build Excel and Python tools to cross-check documents, track revisions and consolidate comments. At Comita, I developed a workflow for vendor documents, from intake and identifying missing items to issuing the response after final engineering review.

comita.title: Chief Engineering Expert in the Planning, Monitoring, and Reporting Group
description: Review multidisciplinary drawing packages and contractor proposals. Coordinate technical interfaces with design institutes, suppliers, subcontractors and the client.

Built a vendor documentation workflow for intake, preliminary review and revision tracking. It records received and missing items, prepares transmittals and consolidated comments, and supports issue of the response to the supplier after final engineering review.
Built a searchable master document register (MDR) that checks documents against client DMS exports and links to the latest SharePoint revision folders across approximately 2,000-2,500 entries.
Automated preparation and registration of technical queries, with links to the project knowledge base. Used the workflow to prepare, process and issue 38 TQRs as of November 2026.
Automated distribution of reviewed maintenance reports using routing rules. In one observed batch of about 100 reports, distribution took 5-10 seconds, compared with roughly 29 minutes manually.

idc.title: Chief Engineering Expert
description: Project Management Department, Mar 2022 - Aug 2025. Project Implementation Department, Mar 2019 - Mar 2022.
Coordinated FEED and detailed design across multiple design institutes for a compressor station and a 400 km main gas pipeline section, including PGD, PZI and PIO documentation.

Reviewed piping, mechanical and civil drawings in multidisciplinary project packages, including instrumentation and P&ID documents. Compared vendor documents with procured and delivered equipment and coordinated corrections with design institutes.
Prepared sketches and redlines to resolve site discrepancies. Personally revised design and as-built pipeline drawings for PIO in Vojvodina using survey data.
Automated MDR/MDI checks, comment sheets and reporting with Excel VBA and Python. Prepared equipment certification dossiers and contributed to HAZOP reviews.

gazprom.title: Chief Specialist, Design and Survey Works
description: Supported planning, schedule coordination, cost-estimate reviews and contractor reporting for gas infrastructure design work, including pipeline, compressor and pumping station projects.
Maintained technical correspondence, tracked contractual deliverables and recorded meeting decisions and follow-up actions.

kuban.title: Lead Design Engineer for Pipeline Systems
description: Helped establish a pipeline design department and led a team of design engineers.
Prepared design documentation, specifications and calculations. Reviewed engineering solutions and resolved technical questions with clients and inspectors.

yuzh-1.title: Pipeline Systems Design
description: Lead Design Engineer for Pipeline Systems, Jul 2013 - Oct 2014. Design Engineer for Pipeline Systems (Category II), Oct 2008 - Jun 2013. Design Engineer for Pipeline Systems, Aug 2006 - Sep 2008.

Personally designed piping layouts and gas metering assemblies in AutoCAD and SolidWorks, including pipe routing, valves, actuators and supports. Prepared drawings, specifications and civil design inputs.
Built parametric libraries for piping and valve assemblies that linked diameter changes to component updates, support selection and specifications.
Produced the SolidWorks piping layout, drawings and specifications for an unbuilt gas receiving terminal in Bulgaria.

skills.title: Skills & Data
skills.description: My work combines <0>piping design</0>, <1>multidisciplinary technical review</1> and <2>document automation</2>. I use AutoCAD and SolidWorks for design, and Excel and Python for comparing documents, tracking revisions and checking completeness.

projects.title: Projects
projects.work_description: Created for my engineering tasks and used in my work: meeting protocols, reporting, documentation, and trend analysis.

blackburn-flight.title: Blackburn Type D (1912)
blackburn-flight.description: Inspect the wooden frame, then fly the monoplane from its open cockpit. Pass through four rings to see photographs of the original aircraft and follow its story.

tabverta.title: Tabverta
tabverta.description: A published Chrome extension that replaces the new tab with a customizable dashboard: search, top-site shortcuts, city weather and a background map, market charts and optional RSS news. Includes dark and light themes, adjustable map visibility and blur, and English, Russian and Serbian interfaces. Settings stay in the browser profile; no Tabverta account is required.
tabverta.impact: Brings everyday information into one new tab while keeping the existing Chrome search provider.

ostatak.title: Ostatak
ostatak.description: A working restaurant delivery reconciliation prototype. Match orders and payouts from two CSV templates, review deductions and discrepancies, and export the results. Runs in the browser in English and Russian. Uses synthetic demo data; AI document reading and Wolt/Glovo connections are not enabled.
ostatak.impact: Makes each calculation traceable to source rows; discrepancies require review and do not establish an underpayment.

document-intake.title: Document Intake
document-intake.description: An interactive demo of a logistics document workflow: review prepared fields from a sample email and PDF, resolve missing information, and export a load record as CSV or JSON. Includes a logistics workbench and an email request for a paid pilot. Uses synthetic examples; live PDF recognition, AI processing, and TMS integrations are not enabled.
document-intake.impact: Demonstrates a document review workflow and provides a starting point for a paid pilot tailored to a client process.

vila-mirava.title: Vila Mirava
vila-mirava.description: A self-initiated SR/EN website concept for a fictional riverside villa with a pool. An immersive hero, interactive photo gallery, illustrative floor plan, and restrained motion use AI-generated imagery. Booking and payments are not enabled.
vila-mirava.impact: Explores a calm hospitality website with accessible galleries, dialogs, and responsive navigation.

vila-borika.title: Vila Borika
vila-borika.description: A self-initiated SR/EN website concept for a fictional timber mountain chalet. A split-screen hero, cream and terracotta palette, interactive gallery, and curved mobile menu create a distinct visual identity. Images are AI-generated; booking and payments are not enabled.
vila-borika.impact: Explores a mountain-stay identity with responsive layouts, keyboard navigation, and reduced-motion support.

vila-tihora.title: Vila Tihora
vila-tihora.description: An independent website concept for a fictional countryside villa. It combines an editorial layout, responsive navigation, an interactive gallery, an illustrative map, and a demo enquiry form. The seven images were generated from text descriptions without reference photos; the form sends no data.
vila-tihora.impact: Demonstrates the journey from exploring a villa to preparing an enquiry, with a fictional property and illustrative images.

belgrade-parking-guide.title: Park in Belgrade
belgrade-parking-guide.description: A guide I created to help visitors pay for street parking in Belgrade. It covers zones, prices, time limits, payment with or without a Serbian SIM, parking signs, and printable QR cards for hotels and car rentals. Available in English and Spanish.
belgrade-parking-guide.impact: Helps visitors understand local parking rules and choose a suitable payment method.

engineering-process-management-system.title: Meeting Protocol Tracker (MPT)
engineering-process-management-system.description: An internal system for managing meeting protocols, engineering issues, and action items. It provides organization-based filtering, discussion history, responsibility and status tracking, and automated XLSX reporting. The repository contains the source code; no public application instance or operational data is available.
engineering-process-management-system.impact: Improves traceability of decisions and responsibilities while reducing missed actions and repetitive reporting work.

geofuse.title: GeoFuse
geofuse.description: A web product for evaluating business locations before signing a lease. GeoFuse combines OSM and Overpass, Google Places when available, Overture and PostGIS building and POI layers, saved-location comparison, source-aware estimates, and decision-ready reports.
geofuse.impact: Turns fragmented geospatial data into a structured, source-aware workflow for comparing business locations.

auto-comment-sheets.title: TOiR Reporting Automation
auto-comment-sheets.description: A Python tool for preparing technical reports, index folders, and transmittals. It fills Excel templates, groups project documentation, and creates ZIP archives.
auto-comment-sheets.impact: Automates Excel template filling and document packaging for reports and transmittals.

pipeline-analytics.title: TOiR Documentation Dispatcher
pipeline-analytics.description: A Python utility that distributes incoming project PDF reports into target directories, transliterates filenames, records operations in JSONL logs, and provides a Tkinter interface for monitoring the workflow.
pipeline-analytics.impact: Automates PDF routing and operation logging for engineering documentation flows.

portfolio-v2.title: AI-Powered PDF Search Engine
portfolio-v2.description: A semantic search and question-answering system for PDF documents. It retrieves context from a local FAISS vector database and passes it to a language model using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Answers depend on the retrieved document content.
portfolio-v2.impact: Searches local technical PDFs and uses retrieved passages as context for answers.

graf-html.title: Interactive Trend Visualization
graf-html.description: A Python/Dash tool for analyzing HVAC trend data exported from SCADA systems. It converts CSV and Excel measurements into interactive multi-signal charts, helping engineers compare equipment behavior, identify dependencies, and investigate anomalies.
graf-html.impact: Simplifies HVAC trend analysis and helps reveal relationships between system parameters without manually building charts.

bb-invest-website.title: BB INVEST Real Estate Website
bb-invest-website.description: A client website for a residential developer in Velika Plana, designed to turn a complex property portfolio into a clear buyer journey. The trilingual experience presents projects, apartment layouts and availability, construction progress, buying steps, location details, FAQs, and direct inquiry forms.
bb-invest-website.impact: Gives buyers one clear path from exploring a property to sending a direct inquiry.

krasnova-residence-website.title: Krasnova Residence Website
krasnova-residence-website.description: A premium presentation website developed for a residential project in Vracar, Belgrade. It combines video-led storytelling with an interactive floor selector, detailed plans, real photo galleries, building technologies, location context, and direct inquiry forms.
krasnova-residence-website.impact: Turns architectural, technical, and sales materials into a focused digital presentation for prospective buyers.

natalya-psychologist-website.title: Psychologist Natalya Website
natalya-psychologist-website.description: A client website for a practicing psychologist in Rostov-on-Don, designed to present consultation topics, formats, pricing, and contact options in a calm and accessible journey. The launch included a custom domain, responsive static delivery, local SEO, Yandex Webmaster verification, canonical metadata, structured data, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml.
natalya-psychologist-website.impact: Delivered the complete path from content and interface design to domain launch, Yandex verification, and search-ready technical indexing.

action-register.title: Action Register
action-register.description: A bilingual web app for tracking team actions, deadlines and outcomes. Managers review progress and accept completed work; registrars maintain records; employees see their assigned tasks. Includes a table, a drag-and-drop board, comments and email-to-draft import.
action-register.impact: Brings assignments, deadlines and the latest update into one shared workflow instead of separate spreadsheet extracts.

pizza-tt426-3d.title: Pizza TT426 3D · Codex
pizza-tt426-3d.description: Built with Codex GPT-6.1 Sol (High) from a 2D equipment plan. Explore 57 equipment objects and labels, select equipment, review dimensions with their stated sources, change camera angles, and export a PNG. The geometry follows the source plan; heights and materials are illustrative. This visualization supports layout discussions and is not a measured survey or installation design.
pizza-tt426-3d.impact: Makes a preliminary equipment layout easier to review through interactive selection, source-aware dimensions, and multiple views.

pizza-tt426-3d-g4argon.title: Pizza TT426 3D · Gemini 4 Argon
pizza-tt426-3d-g4argon.description: Built with Gemini 4 Argon using a detailed prompt and the same 2D equipment plan. Explore 57 records, switch between four visual themes and six camera views, adjust the wall cutaway, inspect animated menu screens, and export a PNG. Includes the anonymized English PDF plan. Heights and materials are illustrative; this is a preliminary visualization.
pizza-tt426-3d-g4argon.impact: Offers a second interpretation of the same plan, with visual themes, adjustable wall cutaways, and a dedicated menu-screen inspector.

electricity-theft-detector.title: EnergyGuard AI: Electricity Theft Detector
electricity-theft-detector.description: An interactive MVP concept for non-invasive electricity theft localization without entering private properties. It combines feeder balance, pole-mounted split sensors, UAV thermal inspection, GIS topology, and AI-assisted anomaly analysis.

tank-nitrogen-blanketing.title: Tank Nitrogen Blanketing

actionRegisterCase.title: Action Register
actionRegisterCase.subtitle: Team actions, deadlines and outcomes
actionRegisterCase.screenshot_alt: Action Register: English task table with owners, statuses and deadlines
actionRegisterCase.screenshot_caption: Actual application interface. The records and accounts shown are fictional; task text stays in the language in which it was entered.
actionRegisterCase.problem: Action items were maintained in Excel, then filtered and sent to employees as separate extracts. Keeping the team overview, individual assignments and the latest updates aligned required repeated manual work.
actionRegisterCase.solution: This prototype explores one shared register. A table supports comparison across the team; a draggable board shows progress. A sliding task drawer keeps the source, expected outcome and discussion beside the task.
actionRegisterCase.workflow_title: From incoming action to accepted result
actionRegisterCase.email_title: From email to a reviewed draft
actionRegisterCase.email: Drop an EML or TXT file, or paste email text. The subject and body fill a draft. A registrar reviews the action, selects owners and a deadline, and specifies the expected result before saving. Import does not interpret the meaning of a conversation.
actionRegisterCase.implementation: The Node.js application and Cloudflare Worker share business rules. The cloud demo stores records in D1; GitHub updates trigger automated checks and deployment.
actionRegisterCase.demo: The live demo uses fictional records and a role selector. Visitors share changes. Employees receive assigned tasks only; the API also checks access. The demo selector lets visitors try every role and does not establish a real corporate identity.
actionRegisterCase.boundary: Microsoft sign-in, mailbox reception, original attachment storage, MSG import and AI analysis are not connected. These are separate integration tasks, not features of the current demo.

manager.title: Manager
manager.text: Reviews the team, assigns work and accepts results after review.

registrar.title: Registrar
registrar.text: Registers incoming actions and emails, maintains owners, deadlines and source details. Cannot accept or reopen completed work.

employee.title: Employee
employee.text: Sees assigned tasks, updates progress and adds comments or results.

register.title: Register the action.
register.text: Enter the request or prepare a draft from an email, with a reference to its source.

assign.title: Assign responsibility.
assign.text: Select one or more owners, an optional deadline and the expected outcome.

update.title: Keep the latest state visible.
update.text: Move a card or select a status; add progress and context to the task history.

review.title: Review and accept.
review.text: Submit the result for review. A manager accepts completed work or returns it for follow-up.
